items.title: 25.3 Synthesis of Pharmaceutical Products (dawaiyon ki synthesis) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 25.3 with Quick Check 25.3 answered (PDF 139-141). Answers need review.

blocks.text: Retrosynthesis ka sab se important use pharmaceutical products (dawaiyon) ki synthesis mein hai. Sainkron valuable (qeemti) medicinal compounds ka structure bohat complex (mushkil) lagta hai, lekin agar inhein theek aur samajhdari se disconnect kiya jaye to hum bohat simple aur aam milne wale starting materials tak pohanch jate hain. Yahi organic synthesis ki khoobsurti hai: kuch achhe retrosynthetic steps ke baad bohat complex aur daraune structure bhi simple aur mumkin lagne lagte hain. Aage hum kuch aam pharmaceutical products ki synthesis dekhenge.
